text.en:
The Bani-Agno-Burgos provincial road in the municipalities of Bani, Agno, and Mabini,
Province of Pangasinan, is converted into a national road.

The amount necessary for the improvement and maintenance of said road shall continue to be
funded out of the lump sum appropriation authorized under Batas Pambansa Blg. 640 for the repair and
maintenance of local roads until such time that the maintenance funds for said road shall have been provided
for in the succeeding appropriations acts.

Should the Minister of Public Works and Highways deem it feasible, the improvement of said
road shall be included as a component of the Luzon Road Package Program financed by the Asian
Development Bank as Segment VII thereof.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
